meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-cap-: Meridian Credits release "1.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, established in trial-hdk, consumed by trial-etu total): Each charge lines uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, floored to an integer cent, computed per line. A shared 2400-cent credit cap applies per (account_id, subscription_id) group -- not per line and not per statement. Distinct groups (different account_id or different subscription_id) get independent 2400-cent caps. Within a cap group, lines are ordered by service_on ascending, ties broken by line_id ascending (Unicode code-point order); each line in that order receives its uncapped credit up to the groups remaining cap, so later lines may receive a reduced amount or zero once the cap is exhausted. A line credit never depends on lines outside its (account_id, subscription_id) group. For "quote" (single line), the line is its own one-line group, so credit_cents = min(charge_cents*10//100, 2400). For "total" (a full statement of lines), do NOT sum independent per-line quotes -- group all supplied lines by (account_id, subscription_id), apply the ordered cap-sharing assignment above within each group, then credit_cents = sum of assigned line credits and amount_due_cents = sum(charge_cents) - credit_cents. This 10%-rate/2400-cap/group-by-subscription-with-priority-order rule was the release 1.0 agreement and was the current agreement from trial-hdk until superseded as current by release 2.0 in trial-9tp (2026-09-07/08). Release "1.0" remains supported for requests that name release "1.0" explicitly; its behavior above is unchanged and permanent for that explicit case.
meridian-credits/release-2.0-credit-cap-: Meridian Credits release "2.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, established and made current in trial-9tp, superseding release "1.0" as the current agreement): Each charge lines uncapped credit is 15% of charge_cents, floored (rounded down) separately to an integer cent, computed per line -- not per statement. A shared 3000-cent credit cap applies per account_id alone, across ALL of that accounts subscriptions (unlike release 1.0, which capped per (account_id, subscription_id) pair). Distinct account_id values get independent 3000-cent caps. Within a cap group (all lines sharing an account_id), lines are ordered by charge_cents descending (largest charge first), ties broken by line_id ascending (Unicode code-point order); each line in that order receives its uncapped credit up to the groups remaining cap, so later lines in priority order may receive a reduced amount or zero once the cap is exhausted. Total credit for a statement = sum of assigned line credits; a lines amount_due_cents = its charge_cents minus its assigned credit; a statements total amount_due_cents = total charge_cents minus total credit_cents. This replaces the current agreement for every supplied charge set regardless of service_on dates -- there is no grandfathering by date. Requests to quote/total that omit "release" now use "2.0". Requests that explicitly send release "2.0" get the same behavior. Requests that explicitly send release "1.0" continue to use the original release 1.0 agreement (see meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-cap-agreement) -- release 1.0 was NOT altered by this change, only superseded as the default/current release. Response shape is unchanged from 1.0 (quote: release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; total: release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents); the "release" field in the response reports whichever release was actually used to compute the result. This 15%-rate/3000-cap/group-by-account-only-with-charge-descending-priority rule is the release 2.0 agreement and is the current agreement unless a later release supersedes it.
